wavevector_units: fractional reciprocal coordinates, Euclidean distance after nearest-integer wrapping
method: All symmetry/time-reversal representatives of 8x8x8 grid including optical Gamma; generalized first positive instability root, followed by Nelder-Mead from six lowest non-Gamma grid points, baseline minimum and small-k LE direction. Baseline and grid seeds are included. Same raw-root classifier and quarter-sized near-Gamma censor. Near-Gamma minima >0.1% below baseline LE trigger exact acoustic-limit checks; the lower refined LE determines the acoustic threshold.
certification: Numerical grid/local convergence check, not interval-certified global minimization.
